title: Add mmdx publish-link command with live verification
description:
No-ragrets success contract, horizon: future agent invocation of $mmdx.

Outcome: an agent can run a documented $mmdx publish-link command against a .mmdx/.mmd file and republish an existing Buildooor short link without direct database access.
Evidence: command preflights the source, encodes pako state, authenticates through the documented API path, updates the requested slug, fetches the live short link, decodes it, and proves the live source matches the local source.
Failure avoided: future agents do not need to remember the manual SSH/psql recipe or silently leave a saved link stale after editing the source file.

Cross-repo dependency: SPAPS Bead sp-app-link-owned-update-api-vhi must provide the owner-scoped app-link update API; Buildooor must expose or document the authenticated proxy/API surface consumed by this CLI.
design: Write scope: mmdx/SKILL.md, mmdx/scripts/mmd.py, mmdx/scripts/test_mmd.py, and tightly scoped helper/test fixtures. Command shape should be explicit, for example: python3 mmdx/scripts/mmd.py publish-link path/to/file.mmdx --username buildooor --slug mmdx-68I8Xjv1v3FK --title 'PDS Project Status Crux'. It must preflight before publishing, include metadata source_sha256/source_kind/diagram_state_format, support --dry-run, print the resulting URL and proof summary, and fail closed when API credentials or update endpoints are unavailable. It must not provide an SSH/psql fallback.
acceptance_criteria:
- CLI accepts .mmd and .mmdx sources, validates syntax, and builds the same pako fragment as existing open/fragment flows.
- CLI can target an explicit username/slug and update an existing link through the documented authenticated API path.
- Dry-run prints payload shape, deterministic hash/slug inputs, and intended URL without mutating remote state.
- Post-publish verification fetches the live URL, decodes __NEXT_DATA__.initialDiagramFragment, and fails nonzero if it does not match the local source.
- SKILL.md documents browser flow, CLI publish-link flow, required auth/env inputs, and the no-direct-DB rule.
- Validation: python3 mmdx/scripts/test_mmd.py; python3 mmdx/scripts/mmd.py mmdx/examples/release-gantt-stack.mmdx --preflight-only; plus new publish-link unit tests with mocked HTTP.
notes: Post-close security hardening 2026-05-22: publish-link now refuses token-bearing API base URLs unless they are https or localhost development, before resolving/sending the bearer token. Added regression tests for non-https rejection and localhost allowance; validation rerun: python3 mmdx/scripts/test_mmd.py (57 tests), quick_validate.py mmdx, and release-gantt preflight.
close_reason: Implemented mmdx publish-link for existing short-link republish via the authenticated Buildooor app-links API, with dry-run, source hash/metadata, bearer-token resolution, live __NEXT_DATA__ fragment verification, docs, and mocked HTTP tests. Validation: python3 mmdx/scripts/test_mmd.py; mmd.py release-gantt preflight; release-gantt fragment generation; quick_validate.py mmdx; publish-link --help.
